class.name: BoneClothCollisionCapsule3D
class.description: A capsule collision for [BoneClothSimulator3D], along the node's Y axis. For a different radius at each end, use [BoneClothCollisionTaperedCapsule3D].

members.member: The full height, including the ends. It is at least twice [member radius].
If [code]true[/code], the collision keeps the chains inside it.
The radius. It is at most half of [member height].
